```{=html}
<div class="leadership-intro">

  <h1>Leadership</h1>

  <h2>How I lead analytics teams and decisions at scale</h2>

  <p>
    I create clarity: frame the problem, align people around the outcome and
    enable teams to deliver work that improves decisions and business results.
  </p>

  <p>
    I combine business context, analytical judgment and practical execution.
    I take accountability for outcomes while giving people the trust, context
    and space to contribute their expertise and grow.
  </p>

</div>

<div class="leadership-grid">

  <section class="leadership-card">
    <h2>Direction</h2>

    <p>
      I turn ambiguous business needs into clear problem frames, measurable
      outcomes and prioritized analytical roadmaps.
    </p>

    <p>
      In fast-moving environments, I test assumptions early, negotiate
      trade-offs and align stakeholders on scope, priorities, ownership and
      decision criteria. I also reuse proven approaches, existing assets and
      prior learning when they can accelerate progress.
    </p>

    <p>
      <strong>In practice:</strong> I have aligned Product, Commercial,
      Engineering, BI and Analytics stakeholders around shared metrics,
      priorities, delivery plans and executive review mechanisms.
    </p>
  </section>

  <section class="leadership-card">
    <h2>Team management</h2>

    <p>
      I take accountability for team outcomes while creating the conditions
      for people to do their best work.
    </p>

    <p>
      I align responsibilities with individual strengths and development
      goals, set clear expectations and remove obstacles without prescribing
      every step. I encourage direct, respectful challenge while keeping
      discussions focused and ensuring the team leaves with clear direction.
    </p>

    <p>
      <strong>In practice:</strong> I have led multidisciplinary analytics and
      data science teams with highly specialized expertise, combining strong
      individual contributions with shared accountability for delivery and
      business results.
    </p>
  </section>

  <section class="leadership-card">
    <h2>Leverage</h2>

    <p>
      I look beyond individual analyses to build capabilities that can be
      reused across teams.
    </p>

    <p>
      Depending on the need, this may include standardized metrics, automated
      reporting, self-service tools or recurring decision processes. I use
      Agile and Scrum practices selectively to improve transparency, ownership
      and delivery momentum—not as objectives in themselves.
    </p>

    <p>
      <strong>In practice:</strong> I have scaled KPI reporting, led BI
      automation and established analytical processes and tools used across
      multiple teams.
    </p>
  </section>

  <section class="leadership-card">
    <h2>Influence</h2>

    <p>
      I translate business questions into analytical work and analytical
      findings into clear choices, implications and recommendations.
    </p>

    <p>
      I adapt the level of detail to the audience and communicate uncertainty
      and trade-offs without losing the underlying reasoning.
    </p>

    <p>
      <strong>In practice:</strong> I have aligned stakeholders around
      marketing experiments, explained A/B testing to non-technical audiences
      and built confidence in evidence-based decision-making. I have also
      supported executive reviews, roadmap decisions and cross-functional
      launches.
    </p>
  </section>

  <section class="leadership-card leadership-card-wide">
    <h2>Quality</h2>

    <p>
      I make assumptions, limitations and uncertainty explicit so stakeholders
      understand what the evidence does—and does not—support.
    </p>

    <p>
      I establish practical standards for metric definitions, validation,
      reproducibility and appropriate causal claims. The level of rigor should
      reflect the importance and reversibility of the decision.
    </p>

    <p>
      <strong>In practice:</strong> I have owned business-critical metrics
      developed by my team, ensuring that definitions reflected business
      needs, were applied consistently across teams and were used correctly in
      decision-making. I have also established measurement frameworks and
      analytical standards to support consistent interpretation.
    </p>
  </section>

</div>

<section class="team-expectations">

  <h2>What teams can expect from me</h2>

  <ul>
    <li>Clear priorities and ownership</li>
    <li>Accountability without micromanagement</li>
    <li>Direct, respectful feedback</li>
    <li>Space to challenge assumptions</li>
    <li>Responsibilities aligned with strengths and development goals</li>
    <li>Pragmatism about when to reuse, adapt or build</li>
    <li>A strong connection between analytical quality and business value</li>
  </ul>

</section>
```
